summary: Independent final review approves EPIC-001 at 4b4a9fbc9639543c0f1515b08089fd93a1c8d7cc with no blocking findings. All eight acceptance criteria are supported by the integrated implementation and current evidence: the committed package is an operator-reviewed Epic Non-Production Sandbox capture, not a fixture, containing 20 checksum-bound raw FHIR R4 resources for Camila Maria Lopez (Patient 1, Appointment 13, MedicationRequest 1, laboratory Observation 5), an immutable 2026-09-22T07:01:25Z capture time, GET-only redacted request evidence, source environment, original resource IDs, and distribution review metadata. The typed frontend adapter remains outside WorkflowState, validates the approved source/mode/review/identity/reference/patient/laboratory boundary, and maps only present raw fields; representative absent fields and families render `Not present in captured record`, while invalid capture shapes fail closed to `Epic capture unavailable`. The existing staff workspace now includes the requested Epic tab alongside Actions, Regimen, Labs, and Graph, with the official checksum-pinned Epic logo, captured/read-only/no-live-sync symbols and copy, demographics, medication, laboratory and appointment facts, original capture time, and an accessible provenance drawer exposing IDs, checksums, FHIR/source metadata, GET evidence, and displayed source paths. OncoReady's generated appointment, regimen, labs, vitals, actions, and workflow stay in their existing explicitly scenario/workflow-labeled sections and never enter the Epic context; Integrations remains a secondary evidence view. Playback is local and produces no Epic request or writeback, reload preserves capturedAt, and capture identity/clinical facts are excluded from public, patient, caregiver, graph, and logistics projections; the code correctly treats publicly bundled reviewed Sandbox assets as a publication decision rather than UI authorization. The digest-approved implementation preserves the locked visual system, responsive layout, keyboard tabs, focus-trapped drawer, focus return, and mobile overflow behavior. Independent TARGETED testing is complete, verification PASSED on production revision b32a740b2468eaa3ca1ecf221e92f9bd287f5602, and all later commits contain only verification, approved security, and lifecycle evidence. The required STANDARD-risk security review approved the exact verified boundary with only non-blocking test-data-minimization and operator-lifecycle residuals. Reviewer reruns passed the 20-resource validator, 29 focused backend tests, 12 focused frontend tests, and the Chromium desktop/mobile Epic journey. The slice is technically credible, demo-reliable, and ready for human-authorized merge; broader multi-patient capture, runtime SMART lifecycle, continuous synchronization, production Epic access, and writeback remain correctly deferred.
